item.name: Public Sample Cases (all 10, organizer data)
item.description: Each request logs total_cost_bdt against the organizer's reference optimum in the console but does not hard-fail on a mismatch - a live Gemini call can validly interpret a paraphrased note differently across runs, producing a different (still schedule-valid) cost. Exact-cost matching against a fixed interpretation is proven deterministically by `npm run test:e2e` in the repo (Gemini mocked). What must always pass here is the structural correctness: 200 status, correct note/hour counts, and required response fields.

exec: pm.test('directive_interpretation has one entry per note', function () { pm.expect(body.directive_interpretation).to.have.lengthOf(pm.collectionVariables.get('lastNoteCount')); });
pm.test('response has all required top-level fields', function () {
pm.test('total_cost_bdt is a finite number', function () { pm.expect(body.total_cost_bdt).to.be.a('number').and.to.satisfy(Number.isFinite); });
console.warn('Live-model interpretation differed from the organizer reference for this run - not necessarily a bug, see collection description.');
